items.title: The fibres of the completion map of a P-ring have property P
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the fibres of the completion of a P-ring with respect to an ideal have property P. The proof verifies the local criterion for property P: the completion map is flat and the completion is Noetherian, so it remains to treat a maximal ideal of the completion lying over a maximal ideal of the ring, where the two local rings are shown to have a flat local map identifying residue fields and with equal maximal ideals, hence an isomorphism on completions. Faithful flatness of the completion of the localised completion then lets the author apply the permanence condition (D) to the chain of two ring maps, the outer one being the completion of a P-ring and therefore having the required property on its fibres.
